title: Indirect prompt injection via catalog content plus GetUserInfo tool plus auto-rendered images exfiltrates user PII with zero clicks
owner_hint: component: src/WebApp/; no CODEOWNERS; committers Stephen Toub, Aditya Mandaleeka (1/2 each)
rationale: Root cause MessageProcessor.cs:24: AllowImages turns every model-emitted markdown link/image into a raw with no URL check, rendered as MarkupString at Chatbot.razor:46, enabling zero-click exfiltration. Adds an anchored allowlist (IsProductImageUrl) accepting only the app's own same-origin shape product-images/{int} with optional ?api-version=N.N (ProductImageUrlProvider.cs:8, ChatState.cs:125); anything else is emitted as HTML-encoded literal text. GetUserInfo narrowing, untrusted-tool-output marking and CSP img-src 'self' are left as defense-in-depth; the sink fix alone breaks the chain.
variants_checked: Only MarkupString sink in WebApp/WebAppComponents is Chatbot.razor:46 via AllowImages (fixed). Other sites (CatalogListItem.razor:10, ItemPage.razor:22/79, CartPage.razor:43) use server-built ProductImages.GetProductImageUrl(id) (no fix). ChatState.SearchCatalog/GetUserInfo left unchanged. Injection vector overlaps f003.
bypass_considered: Absolute/protocol-relative URLs fail the ^/?product-images/ anchor; path tricks fail \d+$; extra query params fail the api-version-only anchored query; encoded/whitespace variants fail and render as text. Residual: model can still print PII as visible text, which is not exfiltration.
test_note: tests/Application.UnitTests/MessageProcessorTests.cs plus a ProjectReference to src/WebApp/WebApp.csproj (no WebApp test project exists). Unbuilt; possible Program type collision with other referenced web projects is unverified.
review_reason: Line 24 of MessageProcessor.cs previously emitted for any URL in model output, enabling exfiltration via image requests; the first hunk now emits only when the anchored IsProductImageUrl regex matches, which fits the product-images/{id}?api-version=2.0 URLs from ProductImageUrlProvider.cs:8 and ChatState.cs:125, and HTML-encodes everything else. No new surface; csproj and test hunks are in scope, though the test covers only the reject case and rejected links now render as visible encoded markdown.
